title: One trial finds the bridge
notes: Two groups of four, every pair inside a group joined, and one edge D-E between them. 12 of the 13 edges are inside a group, so most picks close up a group. This trial never picks D-E, and the bridge is what is left: a minimum cut of one edge.
ops: A-B, A-C, B-C, B-D, C-D, A-D, D-E, E-F, E-G, F-G, F-H, G-H, E-H
